```{r Codebook-Chunk, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)







out2 <- ""


# Grab list of surveys
items <- unique(blockMap$Item.ID)

# For each survey....
for(item in items) {
  
  # Grab survey block
  itemBlock <- blockMap[(blockMap$Item.ID %in% item),]

  item_df <- thisData[(thisData$Item == item), ]
  item_df$Question.ID <- item_df$Item

    
  
  # For each survey block in each survey... knit each question
    thisBlock <- itemBlock[1, ]
    
    if(thisBlock$Item.Type == "Question") {
      attach(thisBlock)
      question_type <- thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name
      question_type_no_space <- gsub(" ", "", question_type)
      
      # Grab chunk labels
        chunk_label <- paste(thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name, thisBlock$Item.ID)
        chunk_label <- gsub(" ", "-", chunk_label)
        # Fail safe to clean any special characters that sneak in
        chunk_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9\\-]", "", chunk_label)
      
      
      out2 <- paste( 
        out2,
        knit_expand(
          file = paste0("DataTypes/", question_type_no_space, ".Rmd"),
          question_text = thisBlock$Question.Text,
          item_id = thisBlock$Item.ID,
          question_type = thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name,
          result_type = thisBlock$Result.Type,
          question_id = thisBlock$Question.ID,
          chunk_label = chunk_label
        )
      )
      detach(thisBlock)
    }

    
    # Now search for each survey in each block
    surveys <- unique(itemBlock$Survey.LongName)
      
  
    for(survey in surveys) {
      
      surveyBlock <- itemBlock[(itemBlock$Survey.LongName %in% survey),]
      
      
      cat(surveyBlock$Survey.LongName)
      
        # Grab chunk labels
          chunk_label <- paste(surveyBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name, surveyBlock$Question.ID, survey)
          chunk_label <- gsub(" ", "-", chunk_label)
          # Fail safe to clean any special characters that sneak in
          chunk_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9\\-]", "", chunk_label)
        
          
                
          
          
          
      
      if(surveyBlock$Item.Type == "Question") {
        attach(surveyBlock)
        question_type <- surveyBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name
        question_type_no_space <- gsub(" ", "", question_type)
        

        
        out2 <- paste( 
          out2,
          knit_expand(
            file = paste0("DataTypes/", question_type_no_space, ".Rmd"),
            question_text = surveyBlock$Question.Text,
            item_id = surveyBlock$Item.ID,
            question_type = surveyBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name,
            result_type = surveyBlock$Result.Type,
            question_id = surveyBlock$Question.ID,
            chunk_label = chunk_label
          )
        )
        detach(surveyBlock)
      }
    }      
      
    
}
```
